name: Reading
blurb: Decoding the script and understanding written Arabic — from letters to unvowelled authentic text.

name: Writing
blurb: Letter formation, joining, spelling, and composition. Composition is self-assessed against a rubric.

name: Listening
blurb: Understanding spoken Arabic — from phoneme discrimination to extended broadcast audio.

name: Speaking
blurb: Interaction and spoken production. Never machine-scored — self-assessed against model recordings.

name: Vocabulary
blurb: Breadth and control of known words, phrases, collocations, and word families.

name: Grammar
blurb: Sentence structure, agreement, tense, derived forms, case (iʿrāb), and syntax.

name: Pronunciation
blurb: Producing and recognising Arabic sounds and prosody. Recognition is scored; production is compared to a model.

name: Comprehension
blurb: Inferential and integrated understanding — gist, inference, stance, argument, tone — applied to read and heard texts alike.
